description: Introduces the Prasrity Scrapmasters, a collective that combs battlefields for wrecks. Their ships are designed to be resistant to d-mods and often release fighters upon death. The faction features unusual weapons that complement vanilla armaments.
descriptionHtml: Introduces the Prasrity Scrapmasters, a collective that combs battlefields for wrecks. Their ships are designed to be resistant to d-mods and often release fighters upon death. The faction features unusual weapons that complement vanilla armaments.
discordPostHtml:
Mod by: Mamenchisaurus Hochuanensis

Adds the Prasrity Scrapmasters, a collective of scavengers that comb battlefields for wrecks to return to life. In other words, trash men using trash ships to collect and create trash.

Prasrity ships are resilient by design, being resistant to the effects of d-mods, and even releasing fighters on death: their weapons are often unusual in role to complement the vanilla weapons the faction also has access to.

Download: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1oH41wJ7WS6IMspNK532ekr_6Ndb52iMO
